properties.name: BlueTriton Brands (Arrowhead; formerly Nestlé Waters North America)
properties.place: Strawberry Canyon, San Bernardino National Forest, California, USA
properties.what: In September 2023 California's State Water Resources Control Board ordered the company to stop taking water at 10 of its 13 tunnels and boreholes in the San Bernardino National Forest, finding it held no water right there. Strawberry Creek feeds the Santa Ana River, a source of municipal water for about 750,000 people.

properties.name: Fondomonte Arizona (Almarai)
properties.place: Butler Valley, La Paz County, Arizona, USA
properties.what: In October 2023 Arizona's governor cancelled one of the company's state land leases in Butler Valley and said three more would not be renewed, over groundwater pumped without limit or charge to grow alfalfa shipped to feed dairy cattle in Saudi Arabia.
